title: Core: Layer outline-mode visual rendering
description: Unit tests for the outline-mode rendering flag on layers. When layer.outlineMode=true, the canvas renderer should draw shape outlines only (stroke, no fill) using layer.outlineColor. Find the renderer in packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts or similar. Add tests that verify: outlineMode layers render stroke-only, non-outlineMode layers render normally. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/outlinemode.test.ts.
